name: Shinsou no Doppelt ~Kagachi Kaoru Kurosagiri no Shiigoto~
original_name: 深窓のドッペルト ～輝血香ル黒佐切ノ誣イ言～
source:
Japan, shortly after the war—
Even amidst the rapid changes brought about by reconstruction, a Western-style mansion stands quietly, seemingly isolated from the turbulent waves of the world.
Gathered there are men, candidates for the groom, competing for the hand of a single young lady…….
This is—a tale of pure love and desire, where men adorn themselves with lies and whisper false love.

Set in the murky yet dazzling Japan of Showa 22, we bring you a poignant romantic game of strategy between men and women, each harboring their own secrets.

[Translated from [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QTkUqa8OmJE]official trailer[/url]]
translation:
战后不久的日本——
在复兴浪潮带来的剧烈时代变迁之中，一座西式洋馆静静伫立，宛如与尘世的汹涌波涛彻底隔绝。
齐聚于馆内的男人们皆是新郎候选人，为争夺同一位深闺千金的芳心而展开角逐……
这是一曲男人们披着谎言的华服、低语虚伪爱意的纯爱与欲望物语。

以混沌与绚烂交织的昭和22年日本为舞台，为您献上一场各怀秘密的男女之间凄美动人的恋爱心理博弈。

[译自[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QTkUqa8OmJE]官方宣传片[/url]]
